parentDispositions: Codex supplied 1329 lines of source containing speculative signature/type adapters, an async ready callback incompatible with the actual synchronous transport callback and type/result envelope keys instead of event/result. Parent rejected that implementation and wrote the bridge against inspected concrete interfaces. No returned adapters were landed.

Muse design 1: success requires bounded transport completion, exact write counts, both EOFs and peer notification witness. Forced termination has no normal-completion report; cleanup success cannot manufacture protocol success.

Muse design 2: frozen dependency source hashes checked before launch; whole new/dependency source receipts captured before and checked after suite. This is not immutable execution binding against local file mutation; native admission remains disabled.
Muse design 3: frozen supervisor records root exit and final exit separately. Root-exit test asserts exit7 before/after descendant termination and separate supervisor exit124.

Muse design 4: all independent process handles opened and creation times checked while live before intervention. Held Windows process handles remain tied to that process instance; a second PID lookup after exit is unnecessary.

Muse design 5: input.json exclusive create is persistent directory-reuse refusal, not a durable native recovery lock. Added relaunch-refusal regression preserving old bytes and no launch artifacts. No power-loss guarantee claimed.

Muse design 6-9: foreign response failure checked as protocol id-correlation failure, distinct from envelope nonce validation; sentinel is launched independently of watchdog job; no simultaneous normal-exit/deadline boundary guarantee claimed.

Muse code 1: parent added explicit validation-fault reporting for malformed embedded raw streams. Added invalid-raw peer-report injection after a real valid exchange; false success and absent-report regressions are checked.

Muse code 2: retained explicit 5-second release and shorter outer fixture deadlines. Tests qualify only this recorded host within those bounds; overloaded-host success is not promised. Deadline stop decisions remain independently measured.
Muse code 3: recorder now prechecks README.md and review.json before input/test mutation. No placeholder reviews used.

Muse code 4: supplied reviewer snapshot omitted frozen winjob/peer/linux details; parent read dependency sources and independently verified saved baseline hashes. Dependency source hashes are included in final evidence, not treated as reviewer verification.
Muse code 5: exact Python version recorded in evidence.json; no frozen transport edits. CPython private pipe cleanup remains a version-specific limitation.
Muse secondary: missing baseline records fail closed; frozen test count/case set intentional and documented.
Clean Code Guard: direct verified APIs, no speculative compatibility adapters/new packages, synthetic behavior explicitly named, no native/provider success substitute.
Test Guard: real Windows processes and pipes, independent held-handle witnesses, unrelated sentinel, parameterized protocol outcomes, review-found malformed-stream regression retained.
Docs Guard: commands, source paths and status claims checked against implementation and saved capture; receipts and synthetic results are explicitly limited.

Final parent revision after reviewer snapshot: root final exit7 assertion, unused import removal, guarded raw validation and regression, recorder prerequisite checks, revised case list. Parent reviewed final source.
